name: The Bitcoin Company US Visa Reward Card
summary: A non-reloadable prepaid Visa card for US merchants, purchasable with Bitcoin via Lightning or on-chain with instant rewards.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the The Bitcoin Company US Visa Reward Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the The Bitcoin Company US Visa Reward Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 2.5% on non-base-currency spending.
